name: twentyq-validation-v4
description: Band-selected secret set: creator-generated candidates, judge-vetted fail-closed, then CALIBRATED by playing 8 real episodes each, guesser = the base model and answerer = base; kept only where the measured win rate is in [0.125, 0.875], i.e. that policy both wins and loses each secret. As a training bank that gives every GRPO group a win and a loss to compare; as an evaluation set it is what gives the metric dynamic range, since a secret no checkpoint ever wins cannot register that a checkpoint improved. Disjoint from twentyq-validation-v2 + twentyq-validation-v3 + twentyq-bank-v1 + twentyq-bank-v2. Rates measured at max_turns=21, question_retries=4; they drift as the solver improves and must be re-measured.
